name: speaker-label-captions
title: Speaker Label Captions
description: A multi-speaker caption track: each line sits on a card with the speaker's name and colour, speakers alternate sides, and the previous line stays as quiet context.
useWhen: An interview, podcast or dialogue needs captions that say who is speaking: a name tag, a colour and a side per speaker.
Cues come from an SRT or WebVTT file (with <v Name> voice tags) or from a JSON list.
avoidWhen: You want word-by-word highlighting from a word-timed transcript: use caption-speaker or caption-karaoke.
There is one speaker: use a plain caption block.
author: RemotionUI

variables.label: Cues
variables.description: JSON list [{"text","startMs","endMs","speaker"}] (or start/end in seconds), or SubRip / WebVTT text where <v Name> tags name the speaker.
variables.default: [{"text": "So what made you start making videos?", "startMs": 300, "endMs": 2800, "speaker": "Maya"}, {"text": "Honestly, I wanted to show the work instead of explaining it.", "startMs": 3300, "endMs": 6800, "speaker": "Jon"}, {"text": "And that changed how people respond?", "startMs": 7300, "endMs": 9500, "speaker": "Maya"}, {"text": "Completely. They finally see what we do.", "startMs": 10000, "endMs": 12800, "speaker": "Jon"}]

variables.label: Speaker colors
variables.description: JSON object mapping a speaker name to a colour, for example {"Maya":"#38bdf8"}. Unlisted speakers take the palette in order.

variables.label: Default speaker
variables.description: Name shown for cues that carry no speaker.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Caption text size in pixels; the name tag is half of it.

variables.label: Max width
variables.description: Widest a card gets, as a percent of the frame.

variables.label: Show previous line
variables.description: Keep the previous cue above the current one, dimmed, as context.

variables.label: Enter
variables.description: Frames (30 per second) a card takes to arrive.
